name: Dependencies
description: Larkspur's third-party packages: the version each package.json pins, the latest on npm, which modules use each, and the upgrade each needs.

module.label: {path}
module.description: A directory with its own package.json: the repository root, a service, a package or a tool.

path.description: The directory, from the repository root.

name.description: The name its package.json gives it.

summary.description: The description its package.json gives it.

package.label: {name}
package.description: A third-party npm package some package.json depends on.

pinned.description: The version the repository pins (the highest, where modules differ).

latest.description: The latest version on npm (npm view <name> version).

upgrade.description: How far pinned is from latest. Major means a breaking change: the first non-zero number of the version moves.

plan.description: What the team means to do with it.

dependency.label: {name}@{version} in {manifest}
dependency.description: One line of one package.json: a module depending on a package at a version.

name.description: The package name as the line writes it.

section.description: Which list of the package.json it is in.

declaredIn.description: the module whose package.json has this line

pins.inverse: the modules' lines that pin it

decision.label: ADR {number}: {title}
decision.description: An architecture decision record in docs/adr.

file.description: Its file, from the repository root.

affects.description: the modules its Affects line names

add-module.title: Add a module
add-module.description: Record a directory with its own package.json.

add-person.title: Add a person
add-person.description: Record someone who reviews or upgrades code.

add-package.title: Add a package
add-package.description: Record a third-party package the repository depends on.

add-dependency.title: Add a dependency
add-dependency.description: Record one line of one package.json.

take-owner.title: Take an owner off
take-owner.description: Say this person no longer reviews this module.

assign-upgrade.title: Assign its upgrade
assign-upgrade.description: Say who is doing this package's upgrade.

unassign-upgrade.title: Unassign its upgrade
unassign-upgrade.description: Say nobody is doing this package's upgrade now.

plan-drop.title: Plan to drop it
plan-drop.description: Say the team means to remove this package.

plan-upgrade.title: Plan to upgrade it
plan-upgrade.description: Say the team means to move this package to its latest version.

plan-hold.title: Hold it where it is
plan-hold.description: Say the team means to keep this package at its pinned version.

place-in.title: Say which module has it
place-in.description: Say whose package.json this line is in.

take-out-of.title: Take it out of its module
take-out-of.description: Say this line is in no module's package.json now.

pin-package.title: Say which package it pins
pin-package.description: Say which package this line pins.
pin-package.fromTheOtherEnd: Add a line that pins it

unpin-package.title: Unlink its package
unpin-package.description: Say this line pins no recorded package.
unpin-package.fromTheOtherEnd: Unlink a line that pins it

align-pin.title: Pin it like the others
align-pin.description: Set this line to the version the rest of the repository pins.

affect-module.title: Say it affects a module
affect-module.description: Add a module to this decision's Affects line.
affect-module.fromTheOtherEnd: Name a decision that affects it

unaffect-module.title: Say it no longer affects a module
unaffect-module.description: Take a module off this decision's Affects line.

supersede.title: Say what it supersedes
supersede.description: Say which decision this one replaces.

unsupersede.title: Take back what it supersedes
unsupersede.description: Say this decision no longer replaces that one.

drop-package.title: Say it drops a package
drop-package.description: Say this decision makes a package unnecessary.
drop-package.fromTheOtherEnd: Name a decision that drops it

keep-package.title: Say it keeps a package
keep-package.description: Say this decision does not make that package unnecessary.
keep-package.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a decision that drops it off

one-version-per-package.title: One version per package
one-version-per-package.says: {manifest} pins {name} at {version}; the rest of the repository pins another version

major-upgrade-has-someone.title: A major upgrade has someone on it
major-upgrade-has-someone.says: {name} is pinned at {pinned} and {latest} is out: a major upgrade nobody is assigned

dropped-by-a-decision.title: What an accepted decision drops is planned to go
dropped-by-a-decision.says: An accepted decision drops {name}, and it is not planned to go
